description: Concise English meanings for canonical case views. Complete source editions remain preserved in each case and on the printed-page editions.

summary: A damaged telegram asks General von Kress in Tiflis for information about the fate of army personnel in Baku. The surviving text is an inquiry; the answer is absent.
cases/caucasus/baku_personnel_inquiry.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The sender asks whether ammunition still held at the reporting location should be loaded for the destination. The quantity field is preserved as transmitted.
cases/caucasus/caucasus_ammunition_loadi.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The message discusses tube radio transmitters at Tiflis and General von Kress.
cases/caucasus/caucasus_radio_transmitte.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The surviving ending appears to promise that something will follow as soon as possible, with Falkenhausen and reference 8274/18. The subject of folgen is not present in this part. The literal defective words BAL and MOEGLIHST are preserved; the interpretation as bald moeglichst is not an additional cryptographic recovery.
cases/caucasus/falkenhausen_followup_fra.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The Nobel oil inquiry requests stock and production figures for the different grades of naphtha at the firm and other companies, quantities already delivered, and corresponding information for Novorossisk. The message bears the name Hagelin; the body and its interpretation were published by Lasry and collaborators.
cases/caucasus/nobel_oil_inquiry.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: These messages concern staffing and supplies for the Caucasus delegation: administrative reinforcements, purchases and local prices, electrical equipment, arms and provisions shipped aboard Violetta, radio arrangements, and an army liaison officer for Tiflis. Damaged names and quantities remain qualified in the individual readings.
cases/caucasus/october_caucasus.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The records ask Westernhagen to return for an urgent discussion of market conditions, transmit requests concerning weather and an inspector, and preserve an exact Sofia service message. The purchasing request stresses that reliable local information is needed before buying begins.
cases/caucasus/october_requests.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A Bavarian personnel order sends a colonel to the 4th Cavalry Brigade and requests his departure date; the following part names the lieutenant colonel already ordered there as his replacement. Companion messages concern Tiflis personnel, medical retransmission, manganese purchases and receipt of a telegram.
cases/caucasus/october_staffing.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: This fragment belongs to the notice about German withdrawal from former Russian territory. Comparison with the fuller p218 reception restores part of the explanation that the Allies would assess local conditions before requiring withdrawal.
cases/caucasus/p212_p218_crosscopy.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Replying to telegram 163, the Foreign Office informs General von Kress in Tiflis that the armistice requires German troops in territory that belonged to Russia before the war to return within Germany's borders when the Allies judge the moment suitable in light of local conditions. The telegram adds that the Allies have not yet demanded withdrawal of the German guard from Tiflis.
cases/caucasus/p218_A.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The conditional first part concerns horses carried aboard steamers toward Poti. Its vessel-like names and opening remain uncertain; the later parts provide the firmer context of a cavalry-brigade shipment and horse delivery.
cases/caucasus/poti_first_part_condition.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The surviving later parts concern a shipment at Poti for a cavalry brigade, an abteilung ordered elsewhere, and horses handed over at Poti. They ask for an urgent reply; damage leaves the precise preceding question about the handover uncertain.
cases/caucasus/poti_horse_delivery.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The representative designated BEV K.M. in the Caucasus is to remain at Tiflis. The reply closes with the War Office’s raw-materials department.
cases/caucasus/representative_retention..basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The supply office at Sevastopol reports sending the listed quantities to the Caucasus delegation on the date written 27/10/18. The surviving first part names sugar, hard feed, potatoes, millet and fresh vegetables. This is a dispatch report, not proof of arrival.
cases/caucasus/sevastopol_supply_dispatc.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The Polish Foreign Ministry appoints Waclaw von Ostrowski its representative for Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, with his seat in Tiflis. A recovered forwarding preamble asks General von Kress to pass on the appointment; the courier surname Tydelski remains a conditional historical identification.
cases/caucasus/tiflis_appointment.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: General von Kress is informed that the pioneer detachment may remain in Tiflis. The message carries Groener's name and replies to an earlier numbered request.
cases/caucasus/tiflis_pioneer_detachment.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The sender asks whether a benzol pump is available there and requests an expedited answer. The closing is the explicitly reconstructed surname Seifert, with no first name or biographical identification added.
cases/context/benzol_pump_query.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Asgard is expected at Poti to collect troops. The same message reports that Asgard and Tresivolus arrived at the sender's port on 7 November and asks for acknowledgment. Hopman's diary supplies the independent Sevastopol context.
cases/context/p155.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: An advance by dismounted cavalry met stronger opposition west of `MIRCO`; `MIRCO` was occupied by the enemy.
cases/context/p164_A4.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Monitor Russian and Polish army traffic comprehensively. Radio important material, especially Polish traffic, in cipher through the Supreme Army Command station.
cases/context/p186.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The instruction says to decipher unreadable radio messages using the December key. The separate closing word IRRTUM means “error” or “mistake,” but its function in this transmission remains uncertain.
cases/context/p189_C.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The signals chief reports that the radio detachment at Konia receives the call sign spelled Nathan–Otto–Karl. The recipient is to determine the wavelengths.
cases/context/radio_instructions.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: These transport messages concern trucks, a request for vehicles and trailers, readiness to depart, and orders to wait. Their partial readings keep the damaged destinations and equipment designations visible.
cases/context/transport.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Two pairs of receptions concern loading radio apparatus for Darmstadt, and a lorry carrying equipment including a benzol pump. Comparing the copies restores more of the instructions while retaining their unresolved tonnage and closing labels.
cases/context/transport_197_198.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The surviving second part states that K M has been asked, in conjunction with A A, to send the requested money to BRASSO by another means. The abbreviations and place label remain unexpanded.
cases/finance/brasso_money_alternative_r.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A message to O.K.M. Wistab acknowledges the arrival of a money transport. It gives no recoverable amount or route.
cases/finance/cash_arrival_acknowledgmen.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Hide purchasing is assigned exclusively to Meierkort, which is asked to return the signed contract promptly. Purchases are to continue while expenses are settled later; Wolters is instructed to report in Kiev.
cases/finance/caucasus_hide_purchasing.m.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A request to Supreme Army Command asks for one million crowns a day, carried by ordinary aircraft alternately to Kronstadt and Hermannstadt. The interrupted final instruction asks for small-denomination notes; a complete second reception restores its missing ending.
cases/finance/crown_airlift.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The instruction asks for the money in the smallest possible banknotes. A complete later reception restores the ending of the daily crown-airlift request and corrects an earlier conjecture about the missing text.
cases/finance/crown_banknote_completion..basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: One message requests an advance for Arad following arrangements with the German military mission in Budapest. Another reports that part of the requested crown funds has been remitted and that a severe shortage of banknotes delays the remainder.
cases/finance/crown_cash_requests.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The Caucasus delegation's economic department is asked whether purchases have already been dispatched, when and where further consignments will leave, and how onward transport is to be arranged.
cases/finance/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiri.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The fragment concerns marks paid through the end of October and asks for notice of the arrival of cheques. It retains the Hauptwechselamt designation; the preceding part and payment amount remain incomplete.
cases/finance/hauptwechselamt_accounting.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: If the aircraft at Döberitz has not departed, money is to be sent promptly under special guard by train through Szolnok and Arad to Hermannstadt. The continuation requests arrival notices.
cases/finance/hermannstadt_cash_transpor.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A short receipt addressed to General von Kress in Tiflis acknowledges money and closes with the naval attaché at Sofia.
cases/finance/kress_money_receipt.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A three-part telegram requests information needed to redeem stamped lei notes, proposes arrangements with Austrian and Hungarian banks, and reports that negotiations over redemption are still in progress.
cases/finance/lei_note_exchange.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The message disputes high cash meal allowances, requires rates to be reduced, promotes communal purchasing and provision of food in kind, and refuses an application for a cost-of-living supplement.
cases/finance/military_allowances.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Silk and related material bought in the Caucasus should be resold locally where removal cannot be guaranteed. Comparison of independent receptions restores the full continuation of this order to dispose of goods whose transport has become uncertain.
cases/finance/nov6_silk_resale_continuat.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Three complete source parts on Childs p167 request **thirty million crowns** for pay and purchases in Hungary, sent by **giant aircraft to Brasso**, with an appropriate mix of large and small banknotes.
cases/finance/nov9_crown_airlift_and_emb.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The telegram routes a request through the German consulate and representative at Odessa, then calls for a wagon sale on the best possible terms. The wagon's identifying number is spelled out; a damaged adjacent expression remains unresolved.
cases/finance/odessa_wagon_sale.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: This query asks the oil cartel at Tiflis to report when, where, to which address and by which ship their consignments were loaded from Poti.
cases/finance/oil_cartel_dispatch_query..basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Concerning the request to the Supreme Army Command for money: a shipment of thirty million kroner can only be made in installments because banknotes are in short supply. The Wiener Bankverein in Vienna is transferring an initial five million, in mixed denominations, to the Austro-Hungarian Bank at Kronstadt for the German rear-area administration.
cases/finance/p205_A.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: All premium payments from local funds are to stop at the end of October 1918. The continuation orders immediate notification of every subordinate office.
cases/finance/premium_payment_stop.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The report gives prices of 140 marks for 100 Tsar rubles in Kiev and up to 190 marks in Warsaw. Its continuation recommends allowing more than par for the instruments designated BONS if necessary.
cases/finance/ruble_rate_companions.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: An urgent radio inquiry to Staatsbank Berlin concerns sums paid for the general war treasury through the end of October. Its continuation asks for notice that previously dispatched cheques have arrived.
cases/finance/staatsbank_accounting_cheq.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The message instructs ZITAG to stop further purchases and loading, secure everything as far as possible, and telegraph the action taken to K.M. Its longer closing includes the literal office-like field Q M ALLQ KR DEP and reference 2439 STRICH 18 G ANCH. Those fields are preserved without silently normalizing Q to K or ALLQ to ALLG.
cases/finance/zitag_full_stop_order.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Repeated stop-orders tell ZITAG to halt further purchases and loading. A separate two-part message permits loading consignments already paid for, orders other contracts cancelled, and asks for Westernhagen's prompt return.
cases/finance/zitag_purchase_orders.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: This surviving third part says there apparently is an airfield at the previously mentioned place. Its next item says that only German troops still provide security along the line designated MIROC and the proposed BRZAPALANKA label.
cases/military/airfield_german_troop_fra.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The report requests provisions and trains for Arad for 80,000 men and 30,000 animals, with action through the Hungarian government. A second reception directly supports the strength figures and restores eleven missing coordinates in the damaged copy.
cases/military/arad_provisions_partial.m.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The messages order the citadel to give up resistance, seek the armistice terms applying to Mackensen's front, and postpone discharge of Landsturm year groups because of transport difficulties. A further instruction concerns urgent home leave.
cases/military/armistice_and_leave_order.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Parallel receptions preserve clauses of the armistice and their application to German forces in southeastern Europe. Their comparison supplies missing text while keeping the separate reception dates and source differences visible.
cases/military/armistice_clause_witnesse.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The shared fragment concerns news of the departure of a German armistice commission and an apparent effect. Its closing remains opaque in the primary reading.
cases/military/armistice_departure_copy..basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: One telegram asks Supreme Army Command for the armistice conditions applying to the local theatre. Another asks the Generalintendant for a provisions train to Szolnok on the Theiss.
cases/military/armistice_provisions_requ.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A report cites Hungarian newspaper accounts allowing German troops only fifteen days to pass through the country. It discusses keeping the 11th Army on the Danube while the occupation army withdraws from Wallachia, and urgently requests the actual agreement.
cases/military/armistice_transit_plannin.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The message instructs OKM, on the order of the authority labeled REICHSLEITG, to avoid any fighting, says compliance with demands labeled FRANZ is necessary, and promises further orders. FRANZ is read as an abbreviation for French in this context; the source does not spell that word out.
cases/military/avoid_fighting_instructio.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The cited instruction is to be amended so that the Siegfried troops, too, are to disembark at Odessa instead of Constanza.
cases/military/black_sea_disembarkation..basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Nothing is to go to Braila, and steamers already on that route are to turn back. Onward transport is to use whole trains.
cases/military/black_sea_evacuation_rout.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The report describes an interruption of the wire connection through Budapest. A separately received companion asks about direct communication while that link is unavailable.
cases/military/budapest_wire_break.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A railway message concerns hospital train 42 from Chemnitz and instructs that hospital train 34 be sent onward to the place written VERBETZ. Several routing and closing fields remain damaged.
cases/military/chemnitz_verbetz_trains.m.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Independent receptions restore two reports: the 219th Infantry Division's Danube crossing near Belgrade, and the Arad request for provisions and trains for 80,000 men and 30,000 animals. The copies provide direct support for missing characters and strengthen the formation and strength readings.
cases/military/danube_arad_witnesses.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: An inquiry addressed to the Mackensen organization asks for a response to an Entente report that Romania has reoccupied the Dobrudscha. The message seeks confirmation rather than supplying it.
cases/military/dobrudscha_report.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The telegram says a request has been made to declare the formations dissolved, and orders their remaining personnel to proceed to replacement units at home.
cases/military/formation_dissolution.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The surviving second part calls for taking the necessary measures for the security of the group according to one’s own discretion. The opening HIFUERU remains unexplained, and the particular group and reference number are not identified.
cases/military/group_security_measures_f.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The messages describe soldiers trying to go home on their own authority and difficulties arranging return transport. Companion clauses concern Baltic shipping and the conditions under which departures can be organized.
cases/military/home_departures_baltic_tr.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The message reports negotiations over the Hungarian armistice and instructs German troops to leave. The conditions and reference fields are preserved in the individual parts.
cases/military/hungarian_armistice_instr.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Two receptions warn Mackensen's mineral-oil department not to admit transports from Romania into Hungary because they would be lost there. Comparison of the copies restores the warning's missing group.
cases/military/hungary_transport_warning.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The report gives an accommodation area for a German Jaeger division south of Huy. A separately priced place-name correction identifies Vierset-Barse, supported by a historical caption; the joint numeral interpretation gives correspondence from AOK 18 to AOK 17.
cases/military/jaeger_accommodation_area.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: One morning report from Kiev says there is nothing new. A separate request seeks wagons for a pioneer-park company ready for loading, without which onward movement is impossible.
cases/military/kiew_morning_and_pioneer_.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: These dispatches concern delayed train loadings and the movements of aviation units. An inquiry seeks the flight detachment's whereabouts, gives Craiova as its march destination, and requests completion of transferred units' prescribed strength.
cases/military/late_transport_dispatches.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: General von Liman is asked for regular reports on troops near Constantinople and Haidarpascha: return transport, strength, condition and special requirements. Receipt is to be acknowledged.
cases/military/liman_troop_reports.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Berthelot communicates Foch’s refusal to apply the Western armistice terms to the German southeastern front and the demand that Mackensen’s army group disarm and be interned. Mackensen’s appeal asks that internment be forgone and explains the provisioning difficulties.
cases/military/mackensen_armistice_appea.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The Mackensen army's soldiers' council is told that the Entente insists on internment. Continuing the planned march would be regarded as a breach of the armistice and could give the Entente grounds to enter Germany.
cases/military/mackensen_internment.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A two-part telegram on Childs pp100–101 reports that the 11th Army and all its German elements have been placed under `O.K. MACKENSEN` and asks for orders.
cases/military/mackensen_subordination.m.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The Warsaw Soldiers' Council asks for an immediate report on whether the rumor of Mackensen's advance on Warsaw is true. The query does not itself establish that such an advance occurred.
cases/military/mackensen_warsaw.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: For the period beginning 1/11/18, the report assesses that the Serbian armies with 3 French divisions are advancing toward Belgrade and the literal place label SHMENDRIA; the attack planned near the literal labels VID8N and OO2PALANKA appears to have been abandoned. This is the report's assessment, not independent evidence of the actual movements.
cases/military/mackensen_withdrawal_part.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: This thirteen-part report assesses threats to the occupation army's rear communications and proposes immediate withdrawal from Romania if a general armistice is not expected soon.
cases/military/mackensen_withdrawal_repo.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The medical instructions concern return transports from Turkey. They recommend a sick wagon fitted with stoves and cooking equipment, with hot tea continuously available.
cases/military/medical_return_transports.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The recipient is asked how many German MG08 machine guns with tripod mounts are available in the area and what caliber they have.
cases/military/mg08_inventory.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The message assigns the Generalintendant at `GRHQU` all supply matters insofar as they concern transport and delivery.
cases/military/military_intendant_remit..basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The messages concern contact with Major Kroeger at Namur and requests for the armistice conditions. The person whose arrival is reported in the opening remains uncertain.
cases/military/namur_cassel_armistice_re.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The opening of this three-part telegram directs a Flak unit, whose number remains unresolved, toward demobilization at **Neuhof, south of Fulda**. The middle part now supports a conditional continuation naming the Hanau–Fulda line, enclosures 1 and 2, and formations undergoing demobilization within a deputy command's district.
cases/military/neuhof_demobilization.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The later parts of the report describe French forces, a Danube crossing near the place written RUSTUK, and reserves north of SLOBOZIE. They continue the army-position message whose first part is the p176b challenge.
cases/military/nov10_danube_field_report.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The partial report concerns Romanian mobilization, a state of war and an enemy crossing at Turnumagurele and Zimnica. A comparison with decree 3179 supports the conditional order date of 9 November; two fields remain masked.
cases/military/nov11_romanian_mobilizati.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: An evening report to Supreme Army Command says a Romanian ultimatum demanding evacuation has not been answered. Its phrase “24 hours before the laying down of arms” remains literal; no exact calendar deadline is inferred.
cases/military/nov11_romanian_ultimatum_.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The first part gives the requested repetition of a locally issued reference and states that participation in negotiations, according to the cited message, is pointless. The exact reference numbers, date-like labels and scope of those negotiations remain unresolved; the statement does not establish whether negotiations occurred.
cases/military/nov18_negotiation_repetit.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The stream reports a reached area and then lists areas and divisional staff locations. The proposed fills make SZENTES, HODMEZOE, ERREICHT, RAUM and MEZOEKOVACSHAZA legible.
cases/military/nov22_divisional_position.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: This situation report was also sent by teleprinter through Budapest. Its surviving passages concern the movements and transport of withdrawing troops.
cases/military/nov24_budapest_report.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A conditional reconstruction recovers a report that further trains have departed and a position notice placing an RD leading element at Oroshaza. The formation labels remain partly damaged.
cases/military/nov24_train_report.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Under the existing shared-square interpretation, the message states that the 11th Army's reduced provisioning strength makes further provisions unnecessary. The next part requests an immediate, complete halt to further supplies.
cases/military/nov25_provisions_and_even.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The proposed aviation report gives Bucharest as the march destination of the staff marked KOFL MACK and Ploesti for a restricted army aviation park. The quantity and railway-reference labels remain qualified in the full reading.
cases/military/nov30_aviation_march_dest.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: An evening report says the Sava and Danube are quiet and places the Alpenkorps south of Ujvidek. Parallel first parts restore missing characters; the remaining formation and closing fields contain unrepaired garbles.
cases/military/nov3_evening_report.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The linguistic proposal says that traffic on all routes in southern Hungary is interrupted and that the army begins a foot march toward the northeast on the date label 4/11. The opening I P M ZU1163EPB41N remains opaque. This is an edited reading of the printed garbles, not a new independent witness to the intended words.
cases/military/nov3_northeast_foot_march.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The surviving parts say German troops will leave Hungarian and South Slav territory as soon as possible, and that the army begins its march on the stated November date. A separate short night report is preserved alongside them.
cases/military/nov3_withdrawal_and_night.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The proposed body says that a communication is not understood and asks whether flying units should depart by air or remain here. It does not identify the units or establish that either action occurred.
cases/military/nov4_flying_unit_inquiry..basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The report places the unresolved unit `211?IVD` in the area of `TITELC` by `9 / 11`. An `A. H. Q?` field gives `5 / 11` and the conditionally completed `NAGQBECSEREK`. The final clause reports no substantial aerial-reconnaissance findings.
cases/military/nov4_march_air_reconnaiss.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The ordinary-word proposal describes troops crossing in boats and ends with nothing further of significance. The preceding 19-label field, the LUHLEGKU?G token and the place-like BRFIRBD9 remain uninterpreted; no particular river, town, formation or successful crossing is independently established.
cases/military/nov6_boat_crossing_fragme.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The proposed ordinary-word reading is an evening report: the label ?LPENZOR?S is northwest of UJVID?K, and the literal unit-like field 217I is at a Danube crossing near the place sequence S?ANKAMEN / ?JVIDEK. These opaque labels and the six unknown positions remain visible. The punctuation is editorial and does not establish a particular route or exact formation.
cases/military/nov6_evening_danube_repor.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The proposed reading reports aerial reconnaissance dated 5/11: ferries and loading of horses were observed near the unresolved place written KIAD?VO. The leading unresolved position and designation M5 remain literal; no definite modern place or unit is assigned.
cases/military/nov6_horse_loading_reconn.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The report states that the division has completed its Danube crossing and describes busy crossing traffic at `BELGRAD` and `SEMUM`. The latter place label retains its source spelling.
cases/military/nov7_danube_and_message_r.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: A morning report addressed to Oberkommando Mackensen says a freight train derailed on the proposed Gomel–Bachmatsch route, that a quantity written 2? of wagons was wrecked, and that both tracks are blocked. The unresolved wagon-count label and final reference remain literal.
cases/military/nov7_derailment_and_train.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The fragment concerns news of the German armistice commission's departure, but the effect described by the damaged sentence remains uncertain. A separate acknowledgment preserves its operational references.
cases/military/nov7_fragment_and_acknowl.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The report concerns assembly and onward movement of the Alpenkorps during the retreat through Hungary. Related receptions supply a near-identical continuation and clarify the operational context.
cases/military/nov8_alpenkorps_report.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The report describes Serbian cavalry entering the places written PETERWADEIN and FEHERTEMPLOM, followed by a northward departure of the 217th Infantry Division and a reserve division.
cases/military/nov8_serbian_cavalry_para.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: An evening situation report describes Serbian cavalry entering Peterwardein and Fehertemplom. The 217th Infantry Division and a reserve division are marching north without enemy contact.
cases/military/nov9_operational_reports..basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The body addresses GEN GOUV WARSCHAU, says that the referenced item has been wired to OBOST, and proposes troop movements within the Ober Ost territory. Z0FORT and the opening reference remain opaque literal fields.
cases/military/oberost_troop_movement_ob.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The message reports that Turkey concluded an armistice today at one o'clock in the afternoon and says its terms are not yet known. This is the content of the intercepted report; it does not independently establish the historically effective time.
cases/military/oct31_turkish_armistice_n.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The report corrects an earlier Orient note, assesses shipping and expected landings around Alexandretta, and relays reports of an attack on Turkish positions near Kalat Shergat. Its observations and second-hand allegations remain distinguished in the edition.
cases/military/orient_intelligence.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Childs pp101–102 preserve closely related reports on South-Slav units near Montenegro.
cases/military/orient_south_slav_reports.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Only fragments about “the public” and something that is to “remain” can be proposed. The damaged clause does not establish whether information was to be withheld, disclosed or kept available.
cases/military/p137_publicity_fragment.m.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The proposed wording reports no crossing attempts as far as the damaged place name VARC8IORO?A. A historical spelling provides a comparison with Vercsiorova, without turning the unresolved label into an unqualified identification.
cases/military/p152_crossing_fragment.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The surviving phrases mention a halt involving Weisskirchen and security arrangements at locations whose description is incomplete. They do not identify who was halted or establish the missing geographical endpoints.
cases/military/p154_weisskirchen_fragmen.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: Crajova and Bucharest are to retain strong garrisons until the last moment; four battalions are specified for Bucharest. Their final evacuation is to take place in a single move.
cases/military/p163_A.md.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The fragment lists facilities whose destruction is under consideration. Read with the following part, it indicates that further orders will follow, rather than reporting completed demolitions.
cases/military/p163_infrastructure_claus.basis: Current case meaning and source edition

summary: The conditional third part reports withdrawal from the Danube and Sereth front toward the mountains, with a route through Kronstadt and Hermannstadt. Several equally compatible locations of the missing source block remain in the edition.
